ios.ahead.title: Ahead
ios.settings.languageHint: One setting for everything: stories are translated into it (on this device when it can, otherwise a free server fallback), and the AI brief and forecast answer in it. The interface is in English for now.
ios.settings.forecastHint: Runs entirely on this device with Apple Intelligence. Shown only where it is available.
ios.settings.resetHint: A new random ID gives you a new nickname. Comments you already posted stay, but this device no longer counts them as yours.
ios.settings.resetDone: You have a new anonymous identity: your next comment uses a new nickname.
ios.ahead.notReady: Apple Intelligence is still getting ready on this device. Try again in a little while.
ios.soon.title: Coming next
ios.soon.yourFeed: Your Feed — taste onboarding and recommendations — arrives in a later build.
ios.soon.battle: Bubble Battle arrives in a later build.
ios.soon.saved: Saved stories arrive in a later build.
ios.soon.search: Search arrives with the live feed.
ios.search.hint: Search headlines and descriptions from every source. Pick a category to narrow it down.
ios.rules.title: Community rules
ios.rules.lead: Meridian has zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users. By commenting you agree not to post:
ios.rules.hate: hate speech, slurs or attacks on people for who they are
ios.rules.harassment: harassment, threats, or encouragement of violence or self-harm
ios.rules.illegal: illegal content, or personal information about anyone
ios.rules.impersonation: impersonation of other people or organisations
ios.rules.moderation: Reports are reviewed within 24 hours. Comments that break the rules are removed and their authors are banned from commenting. You can report any comment and block any commenter.
ios.lang.unavailable: Translation is unavailable right now. Try again later.
